sar.reason: Confirmed unauthorized in-person transaction suggesting card cloning.
sar.narrative: On December 18, 2016, a transaction (ID: 3553342) for $30.91 was attempted at an in-person merchant in region 494.0 using debit card C05876-K2. The transaction was flagged by the bank's automated risk system with a score of 0.55. A Tier 2 investigator performed step-up authentication by contacting the customer, C05876. The customer confirmed they were not in the geographical vicinity of the transaction and were still in possession of their physical card. This indicates the card details were likely compromised and used to create a cloned card for unauthorized in-person use. The transaction has been reversed, and the card has been permanently blocked to prevent further illicit activity.

stop_reason: Customer confirmed the transaction was unauthorized.
